title: Is your armor actually a prison cell? 🔒
paragraphs: Is your armor actually a prison cell? 🔒
We live in a world that demands we look unshakeable. So we put on the mask. We swagger. We act like we have it all together.
We call it confidence. But too often, it’s just pride—a heavy camouflage meant to hide the fact that we are terrified of being seen as weak, flawed, or human.
True confidence is quiet; it knows its worth. Pride is loud because it’s trying to distract you from the insecurity holding it captive underneath.
Don't let your ego become your jailer. The truth is the only thing that breaks those chains. 👇
📖 "If anyone thinks they are something when they are not, they deceive themselves." — Galatians 6:3 (NIV)
